blocks.text: Zscaler recommends that your users' devices have rules that allow the binaries and processes for Digital Experience (ZDX) Module. These are important prerequisites to allow ZDX Module to run specific ZDX features.
For some endpoint protection products like antivirus and personal firewalls, you might need to update additional allowlists for full functionality.
If you need to learn more about Zscaler Client Connector's processes to allowlist and bypasses for firewall, see Zscaler Client Connector Processes to Allowlist.
This section lists the file or file paths to allowlist.

blocks.item: The location of files to allowlist depends on your version of ZDX Module.
If your organization uses Group Policy Object (GPO) to push policies on both Windows 32-bit and Windows 64-bit systems, you must add the file paths of both versions to your GPO policy.

To continue using the latest features, Zscaler recommends migrating Windows 32-bit devices to Windows 64-bit. For help migrating to Windows 64-bit, refer to Microsoft's 32-bit and 64-bit Windows: Frequently asked questions.

%ProgramFiles(x86)% and %ProgramFiles% are environmental variables that represent the drive where the Windows program files are located. Typically, program files are located on the C drive. However, there are exceptions. For example, on Amazon WorkSpaces, program files are on the D drive.
